cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Exactly Within Policy
cards.instruction: Agree to every request only after interpreting the policy so it grants you authority, protection, or an exemption.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Of course I'll host Christmas, within our family's shared-effort rule.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. The rule says hosting counts as effort.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not once hosting has been counted generously enough.
